subject: Disputed AWS Marketplace Payouts & VAT on INV-2026-03-1152
messages:
From: Accounts Payable <ap@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: aws-marketplace-support@amazon.com
Date: 2026-05-03T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Question on INV-2026-03-1152 (VAT & duplicate metering)

Hi Marissa,

We've received invoice INV-2026-03-1152 from AWS Marketplace (attached) and have a couple of issues preventing payment:

1) The invoice shows 20% VAT applied to the gross amount. Acme Analytics is a US entity (EIN: 12-3456789) and should not be charged VAT. Our buyer tax ID is already on file with AWS Marketplace.
2) The March metering report appears to double-count two reserved usage lines (SKU xxxxx). That increases the seller payout and the billed amount by ~$23k.

Please provide a corrected invoice or credit memo and confirmation of the expected payout adjustment so we can release payment. Attached our snapshot of the March metering CSV with highlighted rows.

We need this resolved by EOD Friday May 7 so we can close our month-end AP.

Thanks,
Denise Park
Accounts Payable
Acme Analytics, Inc.
ap@acme-analytics.com

Attachments: INV-2026-03-1152.pdf, march_metering_report.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Accounts Payable <ap@acme-analytics.com>, aws-marketplace-support@amazon.com
Date: 2026-05-03T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Question on INV-2026-03-1152 (VAT & duplicate metering)

Looping in Finance and Sales — Acme flagged two problems with the March Marketplace invoice: VAT was applied (they're US) and the metering report looks like it double-counted reserved usage. Denise included the CSV snippet.

Michael: can you validate whether the charged VAT comes from our seller configuration vs. buyer-side VAT handling? If VAT is incorrect, we need a credit memo and corrected invoice from AWS.

Aditya / Laura: please confirm whether any contract terms / marketplace entitlements could explain the duplicate SKU lines (reserved instance adjustments?). If this is on AWS' end, we should request immediate credit and an updated payout schedule.

I marked the deadline: Acme needs confirmation by EOD 2026-05-07 for their AP close.

Action items:
- Michael: confirm tax handling and advise GL/adjustment path.
- Aditya: check marketplace SKU mapping and whether we can justify an internal offset if AWS does not issue credit promptly.
- Laura: prepare the documents we will send to AWS support (metering CSV, invoice redline).

Thanks — Marissa

Attachments (from customer): march_metering_report.csv, INV-2026-03-1152.pdf

From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Accounts Payable <ap@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-05-04T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Question on INV-2026-03-1152 (VAT & duplicate metering)

Thanks for flagging. Quick finance read:

- VAT: Marketplace invoices are often generated by AWS and VAT treatment depends on buyer-seller tax settings and the buyer's tax registration. If Acme is US-based and provided EIN, VAT should not be charged. We need a copy of the buyer's tax certificate or confirmation from AWS that the buyer's tax exemption was applied.

- Duplicate metering: I pulled the March report; lines for SKU xxxxx45 and xxxxx45-RES appear identical except different "usage type" fields. That looks like an ingestion/match bug on AWS's metering aggregation.

Proposed next steps (Finance):
1) Marissa or Sales to escalate to AWS Marketplace Support with: original invoice, metering CSV, and short explanation. Ask for a formal credit memo and corrected invoice.
2) If AWS cannot issue a credit before Acme's AP cutoff, we can offer a temporary one-time invoice adjustment on our side to unblock their payment (subject to legal approval).
3) If a credit is issued, accounting will apply it against INV-2026-03-1152 and adjust the seller payout reconciliation for May.

Please include GL codes: 6001 (Marketplace Revenue), 2400 (VAT Payable) in the redline.

Michael
VP Finance
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: aws-marketplace-support@amazon.com
Cc: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Accounts Payable <ap@acme-analytics.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-04T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Escalation: Case request for invoice INV-2026-03-1152 — VAT charged & duplicated meter lines

Hello AWS Marketplace Support,

We are requesting an urgent case review for invoice INV-2026-03-1152 issued to buyer Acme Analytics (ap@acme-analytics.com). Customer dispute summary below:

- VAT charged (20%) despite buyer being a US entity with EIN on file. Buyer cannot remit VAT.
- March metering export shows duplicated reserved usage rows for SKU xxxxx45 that were aggregated into the invoice, inflating the billed amount by $23,412.50.

Attached: original invoice (INV-2026-03-1152.pdf), March metering CSV (march_metering_report.csv), and a proposed invoice redline (invoice_redline.xlsx) with highlighted lines.

Requested outcomes:
1) Please investigate and confirm whether metering duplication is on AWS ingestion. If confirmed, issue a credit memo for the duplicated amount and provide a corrected invoice.
2) If VAT was incorrectly applied, remove VAT and reissue invoice/credit memo.
3) Provide a support case number and ETA. Customer requests resolution by EOD 2026-05-07 to meet AP deadlines.

If AWS needs additional seller-side evidence, we can provide usage logs and subscription mapping. Please respond with case ID and expected timeline.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: INV-2026-03-1152.pdf, march_metering_report.csv, invoice_redline.xlsx

From: aws-marketplace-support@amazon.com
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Accounts Payable <ap@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-07T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: Case MP-46273 — Credit issued for INV-2026-03-1152

Marissa / Acme,

Thank you for the information. Case MP-46273 has been reviewed by our billing operations team. Findings:

1) Metering ingestion error — two reserved usage records were duplicated during the March aggregation. We have removed the duplicate lines.
2) VAT reversal — buyer tax settings were misapplied; VAT has been reversed.

Actions taken:
- Issued credit memo CM-1152-2026 for amount $23,412.50. Attached credit memo: credit_memo_1152.pdf
- Reissued corrected invoice INV-2026-03-1152-CORR (now available in buyer invoice history).
- Payout adjustment: corrected seller payout scheduled for next cycle (expected 2026-05-15).

Please confirm receipt. If Acme needs the credit applied immediately against their payment, let us know and we can mark the invoice as adjusted on your AP portal.

Case link: https://marketplace.amazon.com/support/cases/MP-46273

Regards,
Billing Ops — AWS Marketplace Support
aws-marketplace-support@amazon.com

Attachments: credit_memo_1152.pdf
